Excuse me, pardon me, sorry, just squeezing in. Yeah, just trying to get to the floor with the Non-Foils Bundle… yeah, the non-foils bundle from the Inside an Elevator Superdrop. I love those cards. So cool. Oh, you’re all going there too? Awesome. A little hot in here, huh? That’s okay. It’s all for the bundle. Look! The doors are opening! Let’s go. Hmph. HMPH. HMMMMPH. Uh oh, we’re stuck. Let’s try it one at a time. HMMMPH. I said one at a time! HMPH! Oh no. Doors are closing…
